meta.cityTaxBase: net accommodation price, breakfast and other extras excluded

options.label: Hotel
options.scales: One room sleeps two, so a party of three needs a second room. The price does not care how many nights you stay.
options.note: Reception is open when your flight lands late. That is worth money on an arrival night and nothing at all on the other five.

options.label: Apartment
options.scales: One flat, one price, whether you are two people or five. The cleaning fee is charged once, so it hurts a two-night trip and disappears into a ten-night one.
options.note: Check the 17 character registration number in the listing before you pay. Berlin requires it to be visible.

options.label: Hostel beds
options.scales: Priced per bed, so it is the only option that gets more expensive with every person you add and every night you stay. Cheapest alone, rarely cheapest as a family of five.
options.note: Private twin rooms in Berlin hostels are usually priced closer to a budget hotel than to a dorm bed, so put that number in the hotel field instead.
